Part 2&3 物品 OBJECTS AI 补全经历

Describe an item on which you spent more than expected

描述一件你花钱超过预期的物品

⚠️ AI 范例，仅供学习 — IELTS 口语全程独立完成，背诵照搬 AI 答案会被考官识别为背稿。

Part 2 话题卡片

Describe an item on which you spent more than expected

  • What it is (它是什么)
  • How much you spent on it (你花了多少钱)
  • Why you bought it (你为什么买它)
  • And explain why you think you spent more than expected (并解释为什么你觉得你花超了预期)

问题与答案

Cue CardDescribe an item on which you spent more than expected

I'd like to talk about a graphics card I bought last year, which ended up costing me much more than I planned. It's a piece of computer hardware that makes games and software run smoothly. First of all, what it is: a graphics card, or GPU, is the part of a computer that handles images and video. It's essential for gaming, and it also helps with tasks like video editing and running certain programs. I bought a mid-to-high-end model, which was a big upgrade from my old one. As for how much I spent, I originally planned to spend around one thousand yuan, but in the end I paid more than double that. I remember hesitating for a long time before I finally clicked the buy button, because it was a lot of money for me as a student. The reason I bought it was mainly for gaming. My old card couldn't run newer games smoothly, and I'd been saving up for a while. But while I was researching, I watched a lot of reviews, and the more I saw, the more I wanted a better model. I also realised that a stronger card would help with my coding work, since some programs run much faster with a good GPU. The reason I spent more than expected is that I kept convincing myself that the extra money was worth it. Looking back, I do feel a bit guilty about the cost, but the card has worked well for both gaming and study, so I think it was a reasonable decision in the end.

讲的是去年买的一张显卡，最后花的钱远超计划。显卡是电脑里处理图像和视频的部件，打游戏必需，也帮助视频剪辑和运行某些程序；我买的是中高端型号，比旧卡升级很大。花了多少：原本计划一千多块，最后付了超过两倍的钱，下单前犹豫了很久，对学生来说是一大笔钱。为什么买：主要是打游戏，旧卡跑不动新游戏，攒了一段时间钱；但研究时看了很多测评，越看越想要更好的型号，还意识到好显卡对写代码也有帮助，有些程序跑得快很多。为什么超支：一直说服自己多花的钱值得。回头看有点心疼，但显卡打游戏和学习都好用，所以觉得最终是合理的决定。

Q2Do you often buy more than you expected?

Not very often, but it does happen sometimes. Usually it's with things I'm really interested in, like electronics, because I start comparing models and end up choosing a more expensive one. For everyday items, though, I tend to stick to my budget. I think it's easy to overspend when you're excited about something, but I try to remind myself to think twice before paying.

不常发生，但偶尔会有。通常是对真正感兴趣的东西，比如电子产品，因为开始比较型号，最后选了更贵的。日常用品一般会守住预算。对某样东西兴奋时容易超支，但我尽量提醒自己付款前多想一下。

Q3What do you think young people spend most of their money on?

I think young people spend most of their money on entertainment and technology. Many spend a lot on phones, computers and games, since these are central to their daily lives. Eating out and ordering food is another big expense, because it's convenient and social. Some also spend on clothes and travel. I'd say the common pattern is that young people prefer spending on experiences and things that make life more enjoyable, rather than saving for the future.

年轻人大部分钱花在娱乐和科技上。很多人在手机、电脑、游戏上花很多，因为这些是日常生活的核心；外出吃饭和点外卖是另一大开销，方便又社交；也有人花在衣服和旅行上。共同模式是年轻人更喜欢把钱花在体验和让生活更有趣的东西上，而不是为未来存钱。

Q4Do you think it is important to save money? Why?

Yes, I think saving money is very important, even though it's not always easy. Life is unpredictable, and having savings means you can deal with emergencies, like sudden medical costs or losing a job, without panicking. Saving also makes it possible to achieve bigger goals, like buying a house or travelling. That said, I don't think people should save every penny, since enjoying life now also matters. So I'd say the key is to save regularly but keep a balance.

是的，存钱非常重要，虽然不容易。生活不可预测，有存款就能应对突发情况，比如突然的医疗费用或失业，不至于慌乱；存钱也让人能实现更大的目标，如买房或旅行。不过我不认为应该省下每一分钱，享受当下也很重要。关键是定期存钱但保持平衡。

Q5Do people buy things they don't need?

Yes, I think almost everyone buys things they don't really need from time to time. This often happens because of advertising and promotions, which make people feel they're getting a good deal. Online shopping makes it even easier, since you can buy something with one click without thinking much. Social media also plays a role, because people see others with new products and want the same. So I'd say unnecessary buying is very common, and it's something most people need to watch out for.

是的，几乎每个人都会时不时买不需要的东西。这常因为广告和促销让人觉得自己占了便宜；网购让这更容易，一键下单不用多想；社交媒体也有影响，看到别人有新东西就想要同款。不必要的购买很常见，是大多数人需要警惕的事。

Q6Do you think it is the rich people's responsibility to donate money to people in need?

I think it's a moral responsibility rather than a legal one. Rich people have more resources, so it's reasonable to expect them to contribute more to society, and many of them do donate to charities. However, I don't think it should be forced, because people should give willingly, and some rich people already create jobs and pay taxes, which also helps society. On balance, I'd say donating is admirable and encouraged, but it shouldn't be made compulsory.

我认为这是道德责任而不是法律责任。富人资源更多，期望他们为社会贡献更多是合理的，很多富人确实捐给慈善机构。但我不认为应该强制，因为人应该自愿给予，而且有些富人已经创造就业、纳税，同样帮助社会。总体捐款值得赞赏和鼓励，但不应该强制。

Q7What kind of things are people happy to pay a high price for?

People are usually happy to pay a high price for things that matter to them personally. For example, many people spend a lot on health, like good medical care or gym memberships, because they value their wellbeing. Others pay for experiences, such as travel or concerts, since these create lasting memories. Technology is another example, as people are willing to pay for the latest phones or computers. I think the common factor is that people pay more for things that bring them happiness or convenience.

人们通常愿意为对自己重要的东西付高价。比如很多人花很多钱在健康上，如好的医疗服务或健身房会员，因为重视健康；有人为体验付费，如旅行或演唱会，因为这些创造持久的回忆；科技是另一个例子，人们愿意为最新款手机或电脑付钱。共同点是人们为带来快乐或便利的东西付更多钱。
